newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Car crash in northern Russia kills six, 16 injured.
newsitem.headline: Car crash in northern Russia kills six, 16 injured.

text.p: Six people died and another 16 were injured when a passenger bus crashed into a truck near Russia's industrial centre of Krasnoyarsk in Eastern Siberia, an Emergency Ministry spokeswoman said on Monday.
The driver of the bus, carrying employees of a local airline, lost control of the vehicle which collided with the truck speeding down the opposite side of the road, the spokeswoman said.
About 30,000 people died in road accidents in Russia in 1996.
